title: 19 trees eyed for cutting, 12 for relocation in Mandaue Agri-Eco Park

blocks.text: MANDAUE CITY, Cebu — Nineteen assorted trees are being considered for cutting, while 12 others are set for earthballing and relocation as part of the development of the Mandaue Agri-Eco Park in Barangay Ibabao-Estancia. The Mandaue City Council approved a committee report recommending no objection to the proposed cutting of the 19 trees and earthballing of the 12 others affected by the project. City Councilor Carlo Fortuna said the area was previously used as a small nursery. It is now being redeveloped into an agri-eco park through a partnership among the city, a private company, and the Department of Agriculture. READ: […]...
